Hi Alex — thanks for the note and the requirements doc. Looping in Jonas (our EU-based SE) so we can cover the infra deep-dive.

We can do a 45-minute demo next week. A few proposed slots (all in both local times below to avoid confusion):
- Wed 2026-12-08 09:00 PST / 18:00 CET
- Thu 2026-12-09 09:00 PST / 18:00 CET
- Thu 2026-12-09 07:00 PST / 16:00 CET (earlier EU-friendly slot)

A quick note on daylight savings: in December both the US (PST) and EU (CET) are on standard time, so the offsets above are stable — no DST flip mid-week. If you have APAC stakeholders we can propose an earlier CET slot to make it reasonable for APAC mornings.

I've attached a tentative calendar invite (.ics) — Jonas, can you confirm you can take the deep-dive and whether 16:00 or 18:00 CET works better for you?

Thanks for looping me in. I can take the session and cover serving/runtime questions, kernel/quantization tradeoffs, and autoscaling behavior. Both 16:00 and 18:00 CET work for me, but I prefer 16:00 CET if we want to be a bit earlier for APAC follow-up. 16:00 CET is 07:00 PST — I know that's an early start for the US team, so 18:00 CET / 09:00 PST is also fine.

Quick checklist I usually run through before the demo:
- Confirm attendees + roles (platform, infra, security)
- Shared screen for their infra diagrams or sample logs
- Access to test model or example prompt set (not required for initial demo)

If you confirm the 09:00 PST / 18:00 CET slot on Thu 2026-12-09, I'll prepare a slightly abbreviated runbook to keep to 45 minutes and leave time for Q&A.

Cheers,
